parts.gloss: inclusive particle meaning even or all

literal: Unforgetfulness towards anyone at all times, without failing if it is obtained, that equal there is none.
translation: If one can practice constant vigilance towards everyone at all times without fail, there is nothing else equal to that virtue.
modern: எல்லோரிடத்திலும் எப்போதும் மறதி இல்லாமல் விழிப்புடன் இருக்கும் குணம் ஒருவருக்குத் தவறாமல் அமையுமானால், அதற்கு இணையானது வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of constant vigilance or non-forgetfulness (இழுக்காமை). The poet emphasizes that this quality must be maintained towards everyone (யார்மாட்டும்), regardless of their status, and at all times (என்றும்), rather than just during critical moments. The phrase 'வழுக்காமை வாயின்' means that if this state of mindfulness is achieved without any lapse or slip, it becomes an incomparable asset. The couplet concludes that there is absolutely nothing equal (அதுவொப்பது இல்) to such unwavering, universal attentiveness.
